prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1082; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained serious injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. If you have received any statements from our client or any other party, please refer those requests to us as well.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page, within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

Additionally, we ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including the insured's vehicle, photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, claim file materials, and any recorded communications. Destruction or alteration of such evidence may result in serious consequences for your insured and for your company.

We look forward to your prompt response.
